exposure: Availability of emergency obstetric and newborn care (EmONC) services
cohort: Six hospitals in the North Wollo Zone, Northeast Ethiopia
finding: The availability and readiness of comprehensive emergency obstetric and newborn care services in post-conflict North Wollo Zone hospitals was suboptimal, with challenges including shortages of medical supplies, equipment, and emergency transportation.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the least performed EmONC signal function in the post-conflict setting.
